name: Saving Throw
description: Roll d20 plus the relevant ability modifier and proficiency bonus if proficient in that saving throw.

name: Death Saving Throw
description: At 0 HP, roll d20 at the start of your turn: 10 or higher succeeds, otherwise fails; three successes stabilize, three failures cause death. A natural 20 restores 1 HP and a natural 1 counts as two failures.

name: Concentration Saving Throw
description: After taking damage while concentrating, make a Constitution saving throw with DC 10 or half the damage, whichever is higher.
